detail: Fixed FR-9 gap: org_structure/service.py's 5 is_org_admin(actor) call sites (delegation can_revoke, list_delegations direction=all, delegation_eligibility on-behalf-of, create_delegation on-behalf-of, revoke_delegation) replaced with expiry-aware _is_org_admin_now(db, actor) helper backed by org_access.effective_permission_values. roles/service.py's _assert_actor_can_grant gained an optional db param; when passed (both real call sites now pass it: roles/service.py set_user_roles and org_structure/service.py create_role_grant) it resolves actor permissions via effective_permission_values instead of actor.permission_values; kept db optional (falls back to actor.permission_values) to avoid breaking the direct unit-test call in test_role_assignment_privilege_escalation.py which tests escalation logic only, not expiry. Deleted stray backend/models_orig_check.py. Added 3 regression tests to test_delegations_api.py proving an expired-but-not-revoked admin_panel:access grant can no longer revoke/view-all/create-on-behalf-of. ruff clean, targeted suite 59 passed, test_delegations_api.py 12 passed (was 9), full suite 306 passed/6 skipped (was 303/6).
